description: This file contains the implementation of the ItemService interface, providing business logic for adding, fetching, and deleting items in a billing software application. It interacts with repositories for Item and Category entities, handles file uploads, and converts between entity and response objects.

classes.name: ItemServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ItemService interface managing item CRUD operations and file handling, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item, uploads an image file, associates it with an existing category, and returns a response object.

methods.name: convertToResponse
methods.description: Converts an ItemEntity to an ItemResponse DTO for external use.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Creates an ItemEntity from an ItemRequest DTO, assigning a new UUID.

methods.name: fetchItems
methods.description: Retrieves all items from the repository and converts them to response DTOs.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item by ID, including removing its associated image file from filesystem.
